about.title: Where human empathy meets algorithmic clarity.
about.subtitle: A creative studio grounded in user advocacy and technical feasibility.
about.headline: I design products that honor human attention and solve genuine operational friction.
bioParagraphs: I am Janette Amoatemaa Sarfo — a UI/UX designer and Computer Science student. My practice centers on the intersection of human cognitive patterns, systemic information architecture, and real-world utility.

Having a technical background in computer science means I don't just hand off pretty mockups. I consider state transitions, component reusability, edge cases, latency implications, and accessibility standards from the very first sketch.

projects.name: UENR Examination Platform
projects.tagline: Calming high-stakes anxiety: Redesigning academic assessments for 15,000+ university students with cognitive focus states and zero-data-loss resilience.
projects.client: University of Energy and Natural Resources

overview.problem: University examinations present peak cognitive stress. The legacy system suffered from intimidating interfaces, unconfirmed answer saving, fragile network resilience, and high visual clutter, causing widespread student panic during timed tests.
overview.solution: Engineered a distraction-free, accessible assessment environment with persistent auto-save state indicators, an intuitive question matrix navigation sidebar, high-contrast readability, and resilient client-side state caching.

research: Conducted 45 contextual student interviews during mock mid-semester exams to identify stress triggers.
Observed that 68% of student anxiety stemmed from uncertainty about whether their previous answer was securely committed to the server.
Synthesized findings into an 'Anxiety-Minimizing Ergonomics' framework: real-time micro-feedback, ambient time-warning states instead of flashing alarms, and prominent question navigation.
systemDetails: Visual Language: Deep navy (#0F1D36) foundation with digital blue (#2563EB) interactive accents for high-legibility focus without optical fatigue.
Navigation Matrix: A structured grid permitting students to mark questions for review, jump seamlessly, and verify answered status with clear color-coded states.
Fail-Safe Architecture: Integrated client-side IndexedDB caching that preserves every keystroke locally in the event of intermittent campus Wi-Fi drops.
outcomes: Successfully deployed across 15,000+ undergraduate and postgraduate students during university-wide finals.
Zero data-loss or corrupted submission tickets recorded during the entire examination period.
Rated 4.8/5.0 in post-exam student usability surveys for interface clarity and calming visual design.

projects.name: Yɛn Egg Co.
projects.tagline: Farm-to-table transparency: Empowering poultry farmers with digital harvest scheduling and subscription tracking for urban Ghanaian households.

overview.problem: Poultry farmers in Ghana historically relied on manual phone calls and informal messaging to coordinate egg distribution. This caused delivery delays, spoilage, unpredictable harvest forecasting, and opaque pricing for urban consumers and bakeries.
overview.solution: Created an organic, human-centric agricultural platform connecting local farmers directly with recurring household and commercial subscribers. Features harvest calendar schedules, freshness batch tracking, and intelligent dispatch routes.

research: Shadowed logistics drivers across distribution routes between rural poultry coops and urban hubs in Sunyani and Kumasi.
Interviewed commercial pastry chefs and household managers to discover subscription delivery pain points.
Identified that freshness timestamp transparency was the single highest driver of customer brand loyalty.
systemDetails: Visual Language: Earthy Farm Cream (#FBF8F2) and Organic Sage (#4E6A55) to invoke cleanliness, natural nutrition, and agricultural integrity.
Harvest Calendar: A touch-optimized visual calendar letting consumers schedule bi-weekly or monthly fresh crate arrivals with 1-tap reorders.
Driver Fleet View: A high-contrast mobile dashboard engineered for bright outdoor sunlight conditions, displaying route batches and digital delivery confirmations.
outcomes: 3.4x increase in recurring weekly crate subscriptions within the first quarter of deployment.
Reduced daily route navigation confusion, saving drivers an average of 35 minutes per dispatch cycle.
Enabled 100% digital traceability from the exact hen coop batch to the consumer's doorstep.

projects.name: xLeidy
projects.tagline: Bespoke elegance made digital: Integrating interactive anatomy sizing guides with an editorial lookbook to eliminate custom apparel return friction.
projects.role: Brand Identity & Digital Commerce UX Designer

overview.problem: Bespoke fashion commerce experiences high returns (upwards of 45%) because standard S/M/L sizing fails on custom-tailored African luxury silhouettes, and customers struggle to measure themselves accurately at home.
overview.solution: Designed an interactive atelier experience featuring an illustrated, step-by-step anatomy measurement guide, tactile fabric tactile viewports, and an editorial lookbook that converts inspiration directly into custom-tailored orders.

research: Conducted in-depth interviews with 30 bespoke fashion clients regarding online sizing hesitation and fitting room fears.
Audited 12 international and regional luxury e-commerce platforms to identify gaps between ready-to-wear and bespoke customization.
Discovered that visual anatomical measurement prompts with real-time validation reduced input errors by 74%.
systemDetails: Visual Language: Night Navy (#131926) grounding with delicate Dusty Rose (#D98C9A) and Soft Blush (#F7E8EB) accents reflecting contemporary artisanal elegance.
Interactive Fitting Room: Guided illustration tool showing users exactly where to place their measuring tape with dynamic input bounds checking.
Editorial Catalog: Magazine-quality editorial layouts with smooth image transitions and instant artisan provenance stories.
outcomes: 68% reduction in sizing alterations and customer garment return inquiries.
Average user engagement time on the curated lookbook increased to 4.2 minutes.
Boosted overall cart-to-checkout conversion rate by 38% for the launch season.

philosophy.title: The Method: From ambiguity to intentional clarity.
philosophy.subtitle: Great UX is not decorated at the end; it is synthesized through rigorous inquiry, systems mapping, and iterative validation.

steps.title: Inquiry & Immersion
steps.desc: I interview real stakeholders, observe behavioral bottlenecks in their native environment, and map the emotional friction points before generating solutions.

steps.title: Information Architecture
steps.desc: Structuring data models, navigational hierarchies, and user journeys. My computer science background ensures data flow aligns cleanly with interface logic.

steps.title: Systemic UI & Tokens
steps.desc: Building purposeful design systems with distinct domain personalities. Establishing typography scales, accessible color ratios, and component variables.

steps.title: Validation & Code Hand-off
steps.desc: Testing interactive prototypes with users and producing structured developer hand-off specs that minimize implementation ambiguities.

manifesto.label: The Studio Standard
manifesto.quote: When deciding between something visually impressive and something clear, choose clarity. Visual identity must elevate human capability, never obscure it.
manifesto.author: — Janette Amoatemaa Sarfo
